apc/ar201@1.description: The APC NetShelter two-post open frame rack, 45U, with tapped #12-24 holes. Equipment is mounted on the front rails only, to a depth of 1048 mm.
apc/ar201@1.name: ar201

part-numbers.AR201: APC NetShelter Open Frame Rack, 2 Post, 45U, 12-24 Threaded Holes, Black

apc/ar203a@1.description: The APC NetShelter four-post open frame rack, 44U, with 9.5 mm square holes for M6 cage nuts. Rail depth is fixed by its side frame brackets. Rated for a static load only. The AR204A is the same frame with tapped #12-24 holes.
apc/ar203a@1.name: ar203a

part-numbers.AR203A: APC NetShelter Open Frame Rack, 4 Post, 44U, Square Holes

generic/2-post-frame@1.description: A generic two-post open frame: two uprights, equipment on the front rail only. Its numbers are the Rack Builder's generic two-post frame, with the hole centres and opening a 19-inch rail has.
generic/2-post-frame@1.name: 2-post-frame

generic/4-post-cabinet@1.description: The rail geometry of a generic enclosed four-post cabinet, with the rail depth set in steps where a cabinet is built. Doors, panels and zero-U channels are a maker's and are not stated here.
generic/4-post-cabinet@1.name: 4-post-cabinet

generic/4-post-frame@1.description: A generic four-post open frame: front and rear rails, with the rail depth set where a frame is built. Its numbers are the Rack Builder's generic four-post frame, with the hole centres and opening a 19-inch rail has.
generic/4-post-frame@1.name: 4-post-frame
